_about: Corrections to the vendored Smithy model, for shapes whose declared
pattern is stricter than the service it describes. Each correction pins
the exact upstream pattern it replaces, so a re-vendor that changes it
fails the loader rather than applying a correction to text it was never

_evidence: GetFunctionCodeSigningConfig answers a function with no code signing
configuration attached with an empty CodeSigningConfigArn, and the
response member a minimum length of 0. The pattern cannot match the empty
string, so the correction admits it alongside the ARN and changes nothing
